subject: [PATCH 36/60] mm: refuse explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch author posted the original patch and a duplicate message via B4 Relay. No technical concerns or suggestions were raised in these messages.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the handling of private nodes in the Linux kernel's memory management system. Specifically, it addresses a bug where kswapd and kcompactd do not run on private nodes but still accept explicit reclaim and compaction requests. The patch introduces checks to reject these requests for private nodes with an error code -EOPNOTSUPP.
